title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid show highlighted by an unforgettable Lovelight power‑cut moment.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave the recording five stars, praising the overall performance and noting that even when the venue lost power during Lovelight the drummers kept the beat alive. The SBD source delivers clear, balanced audio with no reported flaws, making it a highly listenable document of this mysterious 1969 show.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews indicate strong enthusiasm for both the music and the recording; lack of detailed technical commentary keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues mentioned; reviewers imply a clear, well‑balanced SBD capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show runs smoothly until a power outage during Lovelight, but the band—especially the drummers—keeps the momentum going, creating a memorable moment.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers kept playing after the power was cut, maintaining the groove through the Lovelight interruption.
